title: Combat Max 12 Month Roach Killing Bait, Small Roach Bait Station, 18 Count, Child-Resistant, Fast-Acting Fipronil Cockroach Killer & Nest Destroyer, No Vapor, Fumes or Odor, Mess-Free
features: Kills The Nest: Control infestations and defend your home with this roach killer that attracts roaches in search of food and water. They ingest the bait, carry it back to the nest and trigger a ripple effect, killing other roaches and the entire nest

Long Residual Action: Designed for sustained efficacy, these cockroach bait stations deliver fast control of small roaches 24/7 for up to 12 months. It provides continuous defense against re-infestation, ensuring immediate, long-term protection

Quick, Lasting Results: Formulated with Fipronil, a powerful and fast-acting ingredient that begins working within hours. Contains a blend of foods that German roaches and other small roaches find attractive
Child-Resistant Design: The bait features a secure, child-resistant exterior with roach-sized entry holes. Compact design fits tight spaces like under sinks and behind appliances

Mess-Free Setup: Includes 18 convenient, ready-to-use bait stations—no activation needed. The clean, easy way to solve your roach problem, with no vapors, fumes or lingering odors—great for kitchens, bedrooms, bathrooms and living areas

Fight Back with Combat: We help you eliminate your unwanted house guests where they live and breed. Reclaim your home with reliable pest control that helps prevent and eliminate roach and ant infestations - with baits, traps, and gels
